id.description: Stable slug used in CI and stub messages.

upstream.description: Path or command in omarchy-src, e.g. bin/omarchy-update.

stand_in.description: NixOS option, wrap name, or null.

user_visible.description: Reached from menu, keybind, first-run, or bar.
